_comment: The model picker (bin/model-pick.mjs, P2-227). Each lane is an order: the first model the plan has wins. The picker moves to the next model only when Claude Code says the model is not available (an api_error 404, 'There's an issue with the selected model'); a busy answer (429, 529, overloaded, rate limit) never changes the model. Models found unavailable are skipped for cache_hours. A newer Fable needs one change: put its id first in "legal" (for example "claude-fable-5-3").
